text:
Anita: Heads up — we need panel coverage for the Senior Infra candidate tomorrow 3pm PST. Original panelists were Miguel, Elena, Samir. Miguel just pinged that he needs to swap. Can someone take Miguel's slot? I can do the debrief if someone covers live scribe.
Miguel: Sorry, family thing came up. Can swap my slot to Friday morning instead. @Elena are you still able to do the live scribe? :pray:
Elena: I can scribe but I can't stay the whole time — I can do the first 30m then hand off. Who can pick up the last 30?
Samir: I can take the last 30. @Anita can you update the calendar invite and share rubric anchors?
Anita: Updated the invite and added tentative agenda. Calendar link in event. Quick rubric anchors below — paste into candidate doc and panel sheet: 
```
- Technical depth: look for systems knowledge, tradeoffs, and latency/cost reasoning (1-5)
- System design: clear diagram + scalability considerations (1-5)
- Troubleshooting/debugging: walks through failure modes and remediation steps (1-5)
- Communication + collaboration: clarity and receptiveness to feedback (1-5)
```
Please keep comments short during scribing (bullets).
Priya: Quick q — does the team want the candidate to share screen for the troubleshooting piece? Candidate asked. Our default for infra interviews has been yes. Any objections?
Jorge: :thumbsup: share screen is fine. Also reminder: only record if candidate explicitly consents — verify consent at start and tick the calendar checkbox.
CalendarBot: Event updated: "Senior Infra interview" — attendees: Anita, Elena, Samir, Priya, Jorge. update_ts=1790456880
Elena: @Priya — can you own the debrief doc? I'll scribe live but will be juggling the whiteboard and candidate audio.
Priya: Yep I can take the debrief notes and add eval rows in the doc. Will tag everyone after the session.
Samir: Suggest we keep the evaluation window open 24h. Also can we add a quick 'confidence' column (1-3) so we can triage follow-ups faster.
Anita: Perfect. I'll post a short checklist in 20m with timings, handoff notes, and the final invite text. Thanks all :raised_hands:
